scenarios.title: Endure N puts N +1/+1 counters on the permanent or creates an N/N Spirit

setup.notes: Krumar Initiate is a 2/2 and is untapped.

decisions: A activates Krumar Initiate with X=2 ({2}{B}, {T}, pay 2 life), tapping the three Swamps. A's life is 18.
B passes priority; the ability resolves and Krumar Initiate endures 2.
A chooses to put two +1/+1 counters on Krumar Initiate.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Krumar Initiate has two +1/+1 counters and is a 4/4. No token is created. A's life is 18.

variants.label: token
variants.delta: A chooses not to put counters on Krumar Initiate.
variants.expected: A creates a 2/2 white Spirit creature token. Krumar Initiate has no counters and is a 2/2. A's life is 18.

variants.label: left_battlefield
variants.delta: In response to the ability, B casts Shock targeting Krumar Initiate, tapping Mountain, and Shock resolves first.
variants.expected: Krumar Initiate dies from 2 damage and moves to A's graveyard. When the ability resolves, counters cannot be put on it, so A creates a 2/2 white Spirit creature token. A's life is 18.

scenarios.forge_notes: Krumar Initiate's ability is sorcery speed and has Cost$ X B T PayLife<X>. In the left_battlefield variant Forge's EndureEffect creates the token when the card is no longer on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Endure 0 does nothing

setup.notes: Krumar Initiate is a 2/2 and is untapped.

decisions: A activates Krumar Initiate with X=1 ({1}{B}, {T}, pay 1 life), tapping both Swamps. A's life is 19.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and Krumar Initiate endures 1.
A chooses to put one +1/+1 counter on Krumar Initiate.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Krumar Initiate has one +1/+1 counter and is a 3/3. No token is created. A's life is 19.

variants.label: endure_zero
variants.delta: A activates Krumar Initiate with X=0 ({B}, {T}, pay 0 life) instead of X=1, tapping one Swamp.
variants.expected: Nothing happens when the ability resolves: Krumar Initiate has no counters and is a 2/2, no token is created, and A's life is 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the endure_zero variant the activation has no counter or token choice to make.
